name: bookly
description: Bookly — منصة حجز المزارع والفنادق والطيران والأنشطة السياحية

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bookly/shared && npm run build --workspace @bookly/api && npm run build --workspace @bookly/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @bookly/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @bookly/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @bookly/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @bookly/api && npm run lint --workspace @bookly/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
